resource: One Account bank balance of one World (BANK-0 §3)
allocation_impact: Checked under the balance row lock before any write: a deposit's credit above it is the typed BALANCE_LIMIT and a transfer's credit above it on the recipient is RECIPIENT_CANNOT_RECEIVE_TRANSFERS, never a CHECK abort; migration 0071 bounds the balance and every entry's before and after.
boundary_tests: max=999,999,999,999: a deposit reaching it commits
max+1: a deposit of one more is refused BALANCE_LIMIT with no entry, coin line, event or balance change
a transfer credit above it is refused RECIPIENT_CANNOT_RECEIVE_TRANSFERS
consumers: apps/game-server/src/durability/bank.rs (bank writer: checked before any ledger entry, coin line, balance change or event; a typed refusal or error writes no value)
notes: BANK-0 §8 (owner answers 1b and Q1 b; ARCH-BATCH-ROOT-PACKETS-V1 §1.8 and §2.4); registered by BANK-1 before the code that relies on it.
